WINTER

STUDY 024
Fur Hat & Charcoal Scarf in the Snow
Rights check
Source: 24599.jpg
Warm, cozy, adventurous
WORKING NOTES
- The layered textures of fur, wool, and embroidery define
the look.
- Add 'soft sunlight on the snow' to strengthen the warm
glow.
Try this: Add soft sunlight on the snow.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman sits on a
snowbank in a brown fur-trimmed hat
and a long charcoal wool scarf. She
wears a tan embroidered shawl over a
dark wool coat and holds white gloves in
her lap. Her face is turned to the side,
with hair blowing loose at her temple
and a soft red lip. Bright winter sun, a
palette of charcoal, camel, cream, and
icy blue. Warm and adventurous, in the
style of a winter travel editorial.
